name: Catoni / lambda bound
tagline: PAC-Bayes-lambda (Catoni) bound with a learnable lambda jointly optimized with the posterior.
diff_from_baseline: Catoni, 'PAC-Bayesian Supervised Classification' (2007); Thiemann et al., 'A Strongly Quasiconvex PAC-Bayesian Bound' (ALT 2017). Standard fclassic-vs-flamb comparison; tighter than McAllester when lambda is well-tuned.

name: McAllester / Maurer bound
tagline: Classic PAC-Bayes bound: empirical risk plus sqrt of KL term.
diff_from_baseline: McAllester, 'Some PAC-Bayesian Theorems' (Mach. Learn. 1999); Maurer (2004) tightened constant. Default PAC-Bayes baseline; PBB 'fclassic' branch.

name: Quadratic / fquad bound
tagline: PAC-Bayes-quadratic bound on bounded NLL (rescaled to [0,1] via 1/log(1/pmin)).
diff_from_baseline: Rivasplata, Kuzborskij, Szepesvari, Shawe-Taylor, 'PAC-Bayes Analysis Beyond the Usual Bounds' (NeurIPS 2020); Perez-Ortiz et al., 'Tighter Risk Certificates for Neural Networks' (JMLR 2021). PBB 'fquad' branch; tighter than McAllester at low empirical risk.
